visuals.alt: A short visual summary of BSc Nursing Scope Abroad.
visuals.caption: Key points at a glance.
visuals.heading: Do This Week

items.text: This week builds a plan you can check yourself.
A specialty and a clean evidence file count for more than the country's name.
A nurse applies to one US state nursing regulator, registers for the NCLEX-RN with Pearson and sits the exam once the Authorization to Test arrives.
November 2026 EB-3 cut-off dates: India 22 January 2014, rest of the world 15 June 2024.
Only applicants with an earlier priority date can get a visa number now.
India's own count fell from 9,249 to 4,215, a 54.4% drop.
The UK is still a real route, but a nurse who applies with only a degree and an English test now competes in a smaller market.
All four begin with an assessment of your qualification, so plan for a long paperwork stage before any offer.
What you clear An NNAS assessment first, then the college of the province where you want to work.
Watch out Healthcare is an Express Entry category group, but an invitation does not license you to practise.
The four questions test whether a move abroad fits your life, and the three proofs after them test whether your file is ready to be trusted by a regulator and an employer.
Hospital nursing abroad is still shift work with patients, and the new place adds distance from family.
Talk to one nurse who moved in the last two years, not the one the agent introduces.
A salaried nursing job abroad stays inside an employer's pay band.
A specialty you can price
ICU, dialysis, theatre and mental health nursing take extra training and proof.

blocks.heading: Check the Recruiting Agent on the Government

items.text: The regulator publishes what its exam covers, and much of the practice material is free.
Exams and checks run alongside work.

visuals.heading: Gulf: Fastest Start, Weakest Protection

items.text: The same page says most nurse packages cover housing or an allowance, listed at about AED 2,000 to 5,000 a month, so the cash you save can be higher.
The route is usually shorter than the UK or US routes, but each country has its own exam and rules.

blocks.heading: Safer Path: Build First, Move Second

items.text: Work in India in a ward or specialty unit and keep your registration current.
Run one short test: pick a country and complete one step, such as the English test or a credential check, at the pace your life allows.
Take the next step only if the first one did not surprise you with cost or paperwork.
